replacements.El conector: punto de diseño crítico: The connector: a critical design point
replacements.En la arquitectura encoder-conector-LLM,: In the encoder-connector-LLM architecture, the connector determines how much visual information reaches the language model and at what cost. Two variants dominate in practice, with opposite design philosophies.
replacements.La imagen se procesa completamente antes: The image is processed completely before generation begins. The LLM receives a fixed representation: it cannot return to the image during generation to look for additional details.
replacements.encoder y LLM preentrenados; solo el con: pretrained encoder and LLM; only the connector is adapted
replacements.latencia de inferencia independiente de: inference latency independent of response length
replacements.compresión fija: el LLM recibe siempre e: fixed compression: the LLM always receives the same number of tokens regardless of image resolution
replacements.Por qué el tamaño fijo es una ventaja en: Why fixed size is an advantage in production
replacements.Una imagen de 224×224 y una de 1024×1024: A 224×224 image and a 1024×1024 image produce exactly 32 input tokens for the LLM. Inference cost is predictable regardless of the image.
replacements.Compresión fija. Coste predecible. Cuell: Fixed compression. Predictable cost. Explicit bottleneck.
replacements.Sin compresión. Información espacial com: No compression. Full spatial information. The LLM interprets it.
replacements.Un conector más simple es deliberado: el: The simpler connector is deliberate: the LLM is powerful enough to learn how to interpret projected visual representations during fine-tuning, without requiring a complex compression module.
